description: Core data model: Pipe entity (Kanban board) with ordered Phases, labels, and start form fields
ui_details: TBD — not yet observed in UI. Docs-derived only.
behavior: A Pipe has id, uuid, name, color, users_count, cards_count, opened_cards_count. Has many ordered Phases, Labels ({id,name,color}), start_form_fields, and members ({user{id,email}, role_name}).
data_model: pipes: id, uuid, name, color, org_id (fk). labels: id, pipe_id (fk), name, color.

unit.name: pipe creation assigns default color and empty phase list
unit.description: Creating a pipe with only a name should succeed and produce sane defaults
unit.expected_output: Pipe row with generated id/uuid, cards_count=0, opened_cards_count=0

e2e.name: create a new pipe from the dashboard
e2e.expected: Redirects to the new pipe's Kanban board with one default phase visible

edge_cases.name: duplicate pipe name
steps: Create two pipes with the identical name
edge_cases.expected: Both are created; names are not required to be unique (matches target behavior — verify against real UI)

description: Core data model: Phase entity — an ordered column within a Pipe's Kanban board, holding a set of Fields
ui_details: TBD — not yet observed in UI.
behavior: A Phase has id, name, done (boolean, marks terminal phase), cards_count, and an ordered list of Fields. Phases belong to exactly one Pipe and are ordered left-to-right on the board.
data_model: phases: id, pipe_id (fk), name, position (int), done (bool)

unit.name: phase ordering by position
unit.description: Phases for a pipe are returned sorted by position ascending
unit.input: listPhases(pipeId) after inserting phases with positions [2,0,1]

unit.name: marking a phase done
unit.description: Setting done=true flags a phase as terminal for reporting purposes

e2e.name: reorder phases via drag and drop
steps: Navigate to a pipe's Kanban board
Drag the second column's header before the first column's header
e2e.expected: Column order updates and persists after page reload

edge_cases.name: delete a phase that has cards in it
steps: Attempt to delete a phase containing 1+ cards
edge_cases.expected: Blocked with an error, or cards are migrated to an adjacent phase — verify exact behavior against real UI

description: Core data model: Field type system (23 types) shared across phase fields, start form fields, and table fields
ui_details: TBD — not yet observed in UI.
behavior: A Field has id (slug auto-generated from label), label, type, required, help, description, editable, minimal_view, and options (for choice types). Field types: assignee_select, attachment, checklist_horizontal, checklist_vertical, cnpj, connector, cpf, currency, date, datetime, due_date, email, id, label_select, long_text, number, phone, radio_horizontal, radio_vertical, select, short_text, statement, time. connector fields reference another pipe or table via connectedRepoId.
data_model: fields: id (slug, unique per phase/table), owner_type (phase|start_form|table), owner_id (fk), label, type (enum), required (bool), help (text), description (text), editable (bool), minimal_view (bool), options (jsonb array), connector_target_id (fk, nullable)

unit.name: field id slug generation
unit.description: Field id is generated from the label: lowercased, special chars/spaces replaced with underscores

unit.name: select/radio/checklist fields require options
unit.description: Choice-type fields must be created with a non-empty options array
unit.expected_output: Validation error: options required for select type

unit.name: id and statement fields reject value updates
unit.description: These two types are display-only per the target's docs
unit.expected_output: Error: field type is not editable

e2e.name: add a new select field to a phase
e2e.expected: New 'Priority' select field appears on cards in that phase with the three options in the dropdown

edge_cases.name: duplicate field label in the same phase
steps: Create a field labeled 'Name', then create another field labeled 'Name' in the same phase
edge_cases.expected: Either rejected as duplicate id, or auto-suffixed (e.g. 'name_2') — verify against real UI

description: Core data model: Card entity — the unit of work moving through a Pipe's phases, holding Card Field Values
ui_details: TBD — not yet observed in UI.
behavior: A Card has id, title, done (bool), updated_at, belongs to a current phase, and has many field values ({name, value, filled_at, field}). Cards move between phases; moving a card updates its current phase and can trigger automations.
data_model: cards: id, pipe_id (fk), phase_id (fk), title, done (bool), created_at, updated_at. card_field_values: id, card_id (fk), field_id (fk), value (text), filled_at

unit.name: moving a card updates phase_id and cards_count on both phases
unit.description: moveCardToPhase decrements the source phase's cards_count and increments the destination's
unit.expected_output: card.phase_id === toPhaseId; source phase cards_count -1; dest phase cards_count +1

unit.name: card requires a title
unit.description: Cards cannot be created without a title

e2e.name: drag a card from one phase column to the next
steps: Navigate to a pipe's Kanban board
Locate a card in the first column
Drag it into the second column
e2e.expected: Card renders under the second column's header; card count badges update on both columns

e2e.name: card cannot move to a phase that rejects it
steps: Attempt to move a card to a phase with unmet required-field conditions, if such a rule exists
e2e.expected: Move is rejected with an inline error matching the target's 'Card could not be moved to phase' error shape

edge_cases.name: very long card title
steps: Create a card with a 1000-character title
edge_cases.expected: Either truncated per a max length or stored in full — verify against real UI; title should not break the Kanban layout

description: Database Table entity — spreadsheet-like structured data object, separate from Pipes, with its own fields and records
ui_details: TBD — not yet observed in UI.
behavior: A Table has id (alphanumeric), name, public (bool), and table_fields (same type system as phase fields). A Table Record has id, title, and record_fields with rich per-type value columns (date_value, datetime_value, float_value, native_value, report_value).
data_model: tables: id, org_id (fk), name, public (bool). table_records: id, table_id (fk), title, created_at, updated_at. table_record_field_values: id, record_id (fk), field_id (fk), value (text), date_value, datetime_value, float_value

unit.name: table record field value stores typed value alongside raw value
unit.description: A date-type field value populates both value (text) and date_value (date) columns
unit.expected_output: record_field.value === '25/12/2026'; record_field.date_value is a valid parsed date

e2e.name: create a new record in a database table
steps: Navigate to a Database Table's grid view
e2e.expected: New row appears in the grid with the entered values

edge_cases.name: empty table (no records)
steps: Navigate to a table with zero records
edge_cases.expected: Empty state message shown instead of an empty grid

description: TypeScript SDK wrapping the clone's own REST API with typed methods mirroring Pipefy's GraphQL resource names
behavior: Target offers no npm/pip client library — its DX is GraphQL-only. Per spec-inspect.md SDK scope rules (TypeScript/Node only), the clone ships a thin TS SDK: client.pipes.get(id), client.pipes.create({name}), client.cards.create({pipeId, title, fields}), client.cards.moveToPhase(cardId, phaseId), client.tables.records.list(tableId), client.tables.records.create(tableId, {fields}).

unit.name: SDK client.cards.moveToPhase calls the correct REST endpoint
unit.description: Verifies the SDK method maps to PATCH /api/cards/:id/phase with the right body
unit.expected_output: Underlying fetch called with PATCH /api/cards/card-1/phase, body { phaseId: 'phase-2' }

unit.name: SDK surfaces API errors as typed exceptions
unit.description: A 400 response from the API is thrown as a typed SDK error, not a raw fetch Response
unit.input: client.cards.create({ pipeId: 'p1', title: '' })  // server rejects empty title
unit.expected_output: Throws PipefyCloneApiError with status 400 and a message field

edge_cases.name: SDK call with missing required field
edge_cases.expected: Throws a validation error before making the network request

description: Webhook registration and outbound event delivery for pipe/table events
ui_details: TBD — not yet observed in UI (likely a settings-adjacent page, in scope since webhooks are core integration functionality, not auth/billing).
behavior: Org/pipe/table-scoped webhook URLs receive an HTTP POST when relevant events occur (card created/moved/updated, table record created/updated). Mirrors organization-webhooks.md and pipe-table-webhooks.md event shapes.
data_model: webhooks: id, scope_type (org|pipe|table), scope_id (fk), url, events (jsonb array of event names), created_at

unit.name: card move triggers webhook POST with correct payload
unit.description: Moving a card fires a POST to every webhook subscribed to 'card.moved' for that pipe
unit.input: moveCardToPhase(cardId, fromPhaseId, toPhaseId) with one registered webhook subscribed to card.moved
unit.expected_output: One outbound POST recorded with body containing cardId, fromPhaseId, toPhaseId, timestamp

edge_cases.name: webhook URL unreachable
steps: Register a webhook pointing at an invalid/unreachable URL, then trigger its event
edge_cases.expected: Delivery failure is logged but does not block or roll back the triggering action
